correctness.rationale: For k>=3 preserve the B-pairings and all F2-zero relations among at most k−1 pebbled positions. On a move with r-dimensional fixed span, the forbidden set of sums of ≤k−2 fixed vectors has size 2^r when r≤k−2 and 2^(k−1)−1 when r=k−1; every prescribed pairing fiber in ambient 2d-space has 2^(2d−r)>|F| elements for d≥k−1. This proves an unrestricted-length k-pebble back-and-forth. For t<k−1, the t+2-variable sentence using t+1 distinct orthogonal vertices and a parity-inconsistent pairing witness holds at rank≥t+1 but not t, by maximal isotropic dimension. Boundary k=1 all nonempty loopless graphs, k=2 splits K3 from d≥2. Independently enumerated all 17 triple pairing/dependence types in S3 and matched their fourth-pebble extension signatures to S4, complementing the universal proof.
